name: textpic-license-server
description: TextPic Studio license server (Cloudflare Worker + D1). No runtime dependencies.

scripts.test: node --test test/util.test.ts test/verify.test.ts test/quota.test.ts test/admin.test.ts test/releases.test.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute textpic-licenses --local --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute textpic-licenses --local --file=migrations/0002_releases.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute textpic-licenses --remote --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute textpic-licenses --remote --file=migrations/0002_releases.sql
